about: A formidable criminal defense and personal injury attorney, Kevin P. Bolger serves clients across the Chicago metropolitan area. With over 40 years of experience in the legal field, he has an extensive background in handling high-value criminal matters, white collar crimes, all personal injury matters, workers’ compensation claims and DUIs. Serving clients from his office at Kevin P. Bolger & Associates in Chicago, Illinois, he provides dedicated representation to the Spanish-speaking communities in Chicago.

Upon completion of his undergraduate studies in business administration from DePaul University, Mr. Bolger went on to pursue his legal education at Chicago-Kent College of Law. He was admitted to practice law in Illinois in 1976 and is also licensed to appear before the federal courts in Illinois, Indiana and Wisconsin, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 7th Circuit. A graduate of the Illinois Trial Lawyers Association School of Trial Advocacy and the National Institute for Trial Advocacy School of Trial Advocacy, he brings elite, battle-tested courtroom skills and persuasive litigation strategy to every client's case.

Over the course of his career, Mr. Bolger has taken on dynamic legal roles, including positions with the Chicago Police Department and as a Cook County assistant state’s attorney. This unique background provides an invaluable insider perspective, allowing him to anticipate prosecution strategies and investigate cases thoroughly. Today, as a state and federal attorney in Chicago, he leverages this experience to build formidable defenses for criminal clients and recover full compensation for personal injury plaintiffs.

Known for pairing trial-tested skills with client-centric care, Mr. Bolger delivers aggressive, reliable representation across state and federal courts. His commitment to achieving suitable case results and maintaining strong client relationships has earned him industry recognition, including the Avvo Clients’ Choice Award and the Distinguished peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
